newsitem.title: UK: NWE GASOLINE BARGES DOWN $9-$10, LATE DEAL AT $223.
newsitem.headline: NWE GASOLINE BARGES DOWN $9-$10, LATE DEAL AT $223.

text.p: NWE gasoline barge levels fell back by $9-$10 on Friday with brokers attributing much of the decline to an apparent decision by Morgan Stanley to halt efforts to squeeze the market.
An initial trade at $216 for first half August Eurograde, $15 below end-Thursday barge quotes, was followed by deals at $220, $222 and $223.
The last two deals for ultra-prompt gasoline pointed to fundamental physical market tightness, dealers said.
A balance-of-August regular mogas trade was heard done at $200 as second half Eurograde was seen done at $213, dealers said.
The swaps market saw three, possibly four, September trades at $194 and an additional deal at $193 as August values fell by $4-$5 on the day.
A Wall Street trader was earlier heard bidding for a cargo at $218 CIF Hamburg by August 20 as NWE lots were heard offered for September 1-10 around the $200 CIF level.
